calendar.text: Nvidia reports quarterly results after the US market closes
Minutes of the Fed’s October meeting
Final euro area inflation for October (first estimate: 4.0%)
Trump, Xi and Putin are due to meet in Shenzhen
Spain: TV debate between Sánchez and Feijóo
COP31 is due to end in Antalya
EU summit: leaders aim to choose the next ECB president
The new US Congress takes office

held.t: Iran: a Euronews report that the US struck missile launchers in southern Iran on Sunday night. No second source and no US confirmation in the reports seen.

Ukraine: a Russian official’s statement, carried by state media, that 1,200 to 1,300 prisoners from each side could be exchanged. No independent confirmation, and no sign yet that the exchange has started.
Ukraine: a report that European leaders agreed a joint negotiating team on 13 November. One source so far.
ECB: reports that policymakers expect to raise rates in December and then pause. One source so far.
China: reports that October industrial output and retail sales missed forecasts. One source so far.
Iran: a Times of Israel report of US airstrikes on Iran’s Qeshm Island. One source so far.
Iran: a Reuters report that the crew of a tanker is missing in the Strait of Hormuz. One source so far.
Nvidia: a Wall Street Journal report that Jensen Huang would be open to returning as chief executive. One source so far.
Nvidia: a CNN report that Jensen Huang will appear before Congress. One source so far.

note: New stories: Ukraine’s strike on the Kerch Bridge and Russian strikes on Kyiv’s bridges, UK sanctions on Israeli settlement builders, the Prague protest for public media, and EU approval of UniCredit’s Commerzbank takeover. Updates: Iran, the Trump–Xi–Putin meeting and Nvidia.
